# Diagnos Lab

> Diagnos Lab is a top-rated diagnostic centre in Sakchi, Jamshedpur (Jharkhand, India) offering blood tests, ultrasound (USG), ECG, X-Ray, PFT, and health packages, with home sample collection across the city and same-day digital reports.

## Services
- [Tests](https://diagnoslab.in/tests): Full catalogue of pathology and lab tests, with prices and home collection.
- [Health Packages](https://diagnoslab.in/packages): Bundled checkup packages covering blood, liver, kidney, heart, diabetes, and hormonal health.
- [Radiology](https://diagnoslab.in/radiology): Ultrasound, X-Ray, ECG, and Echocardiography services.
- [Ultrasound in Jamshedpur](https://diagnoslab.in/ultrasound-in-jamshedpur): USG scans performed by a female radiologist.
- [ECG](https://diagnoslab.in/ecg): Electrocardiogram testing and booking.
- [X-Ray](https://diagnoslab.in/xray): Digital X-Ray testing and booking.
- [Book a Test](https://diagnoslab.in/book-a-test): Book a blood test or package online with home sample collection.
- [Corporate Health Testing](https://diagnoslab.in/corporate): Health checkup programs for organisations and employees.

## Company
- [About Us](https://diagnoslab.in/aboutUs): Diagnos Lab's history, mission, and why patients trust us.
- [Areas Served](https://diagnoslab.in/area): Neighbourhoods across Jamshedpur covered by home sample collection.
- [Contact Us](https://diagnoslab.in/contact-us): Phone, WhatsApp, email, and location details.
- [Policy](https://diagnoslab.in/policy): Privacy and service policies.
